note: The section a kind of notice is issued under when the notice names the Act but cites no section (docs/specs/law-library.md). Each rule was checked against the section's text before it was added; rules are tried in order and the first match wins. Shown as 'the section this kind of notice is issued under', never as a citation. tools/law_refs.py = Java LawReferenceService.

rules.heading: LAND\s*REGISTRATION\s*ACT
rules.why: The Registrar announces that production of the title will be dispensed with; s. 31(1): the certificate is produced on registration 'unless ... the Registrar dispenses with its production'. Checked 4 Oct 2026.

rules.heading: LAND\s*REGISTRATION\s*ACT
rules.why: A lost or destroyed land register (green card) is reconstructed / a new one opened after notice; s. 33(5): the Registrar may reconstruct a lost or destroyed land register after sixty days' notice in the Gazette. Checked 4 Oct 2026.

rules.heading: LAND\s*REGISTRATION\s*ACT
rules.why: A lost or destroyed title deed / certificate of title or lease is replaced (new, replacement or provisional certificate) after notice; s. 33(1)-(3): replacement after Gazette notice and sixty days. Checked 4 Oct 2026.
